card.name: Ability to live and eat freely
card.fires_on: Words inside statements about being able to live, eat or act without limits, such as 'will not be judged', 'able to eat and drink', 'can't feed your family'. It fires on the verb or linking word within that phrase.

modes.description: Verbs or nouns in lists of everyday abilities such as eating, running, or feeding a family.

card.writes: It pushes toward Chinese phrases meaning 'no need to worry', 'will not', 'no need' and 'freely'.
card.plain: It marks phrases about being free or able to do ordinary things like eat, run or support a family without limits.
